news.title: Upcoming dividend of ₹2.75 per share
news.body: Eligible shareholders must have bought the stock before 22 May 2026. Payment date: 27 June 2026. Payout ratio is a comfortable 23% but the company is not cash flow positive. Trailing yield: 1.0%. Lower than top quartile of Indian dividend payers (1.5%). Higher than average of industry peers (0.7%).

news.title: L&T Finance Limited, Annual General Meeting, May 29, 2026
news.body: L&T Finance Limited, Annual General Meeting, May 29, 2026, at 15:30 Indian Standard Time.

news.title: Dividend of ₹2.75 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹2.75 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 22nd May 2026 Payment date: 27th June 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.0%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.7%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (23% earnings payout ratio) but the company has no free cash flows available, indicating it may be using cash reserves or debt to pay the dividend. The dividend has increased by an average of 13% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 79% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: L&T Finance Limited Recommends Dividend, Payable on or June 27, 2026
news.body: L&T Finance Limited announced that at the AGM to be held on May 29, 2026, Further pursuant to Regulation 42 of the Listing Regulations and in continuation to letter dated April 24, 2026, informing about the Board recommending a dividend of INR 2.75 per Equity Share (face value INR 10 each per equity share), which is subject To Approve the Members at the AGM May 22, 2026 has been fixed as the record date for determining the list of Members entitled to receive the aforesaid dividend. The aforesaid dividend, subject To Approve the Members at the upcoming AGM, will be credited on or before June 27, 2026 subject to applicable deduction of tax at source.

news.title: LTF: Higher Margin Assumptions And Funding Plans Will Shape Future Risk Reward Outlook
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for L&T Finance slightly lower from ₹307.44 to ₹305.40. This reflects updated assumptions that combine more moderate revenue growth expectations with a higher projected profit margin and a marginally lower future P/E multiple.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues and EPS in line with analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹11.92 (up from ₹10.61 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹112.0b (up 45% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹29.8b (up 13% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 27% (down from 34% in FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) were also in line with analyst expectations. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 53% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 46% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: LTF: Lower Fair Value And Fundraising Plans Will Pressure Future Returns

What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for April 24, 2026, to consider and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026 (company filing).

news.body: Up from ₹279, the current price target is an average from 19 analysts. New target price is 6.2% above last closing price of ₹281. Stock is up 102% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹12.06 for next year compared to ₹10.61 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.95 (up from ₹2.51 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹28.8b (up 59% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.39b (up 18% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 26% (down from 35% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 3.6%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 6.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 25% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 72% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 46% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
